opening.text: I have chest pain. It started about 40 minutes ago and woke me up at 5 in the morning. Right now it's a 7 out of 10, and it feels like pressure, like something is resting on my chest. I've had chest pain like this before, but it wasn't exactly the same. I'm also having trouble breathing, I feel nauseated, and I've been sweating more than usual. I've had high blood pressure for 5 years and take a diuretic for it. I have high cholesterol and I'm supposed to control it with diet. I use cocaine.
